choices.text: Point out the undercut directly and show Kayla how to adjust her travel angle.
Praise what’s good first, then ask Kayla what she sees along the toe.
Let Arman catch it at inspection; Kayla will learn more from the reject.

response.text: In Stockton, Kayla shows you a fillet weld she’s proud of. It looks good, but you can see undercut along one toe that will fail inspection.
response.title: Kayla’s weld
